name: app_a
description: Learning vocabulary app.

# The following line prevents the package from being accidentally published to
# pub.dev using `flutter pub publish`. This is preferred for private packages.
publish_to: 'none' # Remove this line if you wish to publish to pub.dev

# The following defines the version and build number for your application.
# A version number is three numbers separated by dots, like 1.2.43
# followed by an optional build number separated by a +.
# Both the version and the builder number may be overridden in flutter
# build by specifying --build-name and --build-number, respectively.
# In Android, build-name is used as versionName while build-number used as versionCode.
# Read more about Android versioning at https://developer.android.com/studio/publish/versioning
# In iOS, build-name is used as CFBundleShortVersionString while build-number used as CFBundleVersion.
# Read more about iOS versioning at
# https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/General/Reference/InfoPlistKeyReference/Articles/CoreFoundationKeys.html
version: 1.0.0+1

environment:
  sdk: ^3.10.0
  flutter: 3.47.7

# Dependencies specify other packages that your package needs in order to work.
# To automatically upgrade your package dependencies to the latest versions
# consider running `flutter pub upgrade --major-versions`. Alternatively,
# dependencies can be manually updated by changing the version numbers below to

# versions available, run `flutter pub outdated`.
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter

  # The following adds the Cupertino Icons font to your application.
  # Use with the CupertinoIcons class for iOS style icons.
  cupertino_icons: ^2.0.0

  firebase_analytics: ^13.0.0

  package_info_plus: ^10.2.2

  http: ^1.6.0
  get: ^4.7.3
  in_app_review: ^2.0.12
  flutter_local_notifications: ^22.3.2
  flutter_timezone: ^5.1.1
  flutter_colorpicker: ^1.1.0
  path: ^1.9.0
  platform: ^3.2.0
  timezone: ^0.11.2
  wakelock_plus: ^1.8.1
  permission_handler: ^13.0.2
  speech_to_text: ^7.5.0
  google_sign_in: ^7.2.0
  googleapis: ^17.0.0
  encrypt: ^5.0.3
  path_provider: ^2.1.6
  intl: ^0.20.3
  firebase_app_check: ^0.5.0
  flutter_svg: ^2.3.0

  # android_intent_plus: ^3.0.2

dev_dependencies:

    sdk: flutter
  integration_test:
    sdk: flutter

  permission_handler_platform_interface: ^4.4.1
  plugin_platform_interface: ^2.1.8
  in_app_purchase_platform_interface: ^1.4.1
  shared_preferences_platform_interface: ^2.4.1
  firebase_core_platform_interface: ^8.1.0
  firebase_crashlytics_platform_interface: ^3.9.1

dependency_overrides:
  # 2.5.0+ (Pigeon JNI) 는 R8 keep 규칙이 없어 릴리스 빌드에서
  # SharedPreferencesApiRegistrar.getAll 이 NoSuchMethodError 로 실패한다.
  # 상위 수정판이 나올 때까지 마지막 정상 버전으로 고정한다.
  shared_preferences_android: 2.4.28

# For information on the generic Dart part of this file, see the
# following page: https://dart.dev/tools/pub/pubspec

# The following section is specific to Flutter.
flutter:
  # flutter_tts 가 아직 SPM 을 지원하지 않아 SPM/CocoaPods 공존으로 인한
  # iOS SwiftPM "already exists in file system" 회귀가 발생. flutter_tts 의
  # SPM 지원이 들어올 때까지 SPM 통합을 비활성화하고 CocoaPods 로 통일한다.
  # Refs: flutter/flutter#186054, dlutton/flutter_tts#631, dlutton/flutter_tts#634
  config:
    enable-swift-package-manager: false
  # The following line ensures that the Material Icons font is
  # included with your application, so that you can use the icons in
  # the material Icons class.
  uses-material-design: true

  # To add assets to your application, add an assets section, like this:
  # assets:
  #   - images/a_dot_burr.jpeg
  #   - images/a_dot_ham.jpeg
  assets:
    - assets/data.db
    - assets/test.db
    - assets/images/google_g_logo.svg
    - assets/images/hiragana/
    - assets/images/katakana/
    - assets/kanji/

  # An image asset can refer to one or more resolution-specific "variants", see
  # https://flutter.dev/assets-and-images/#resolution-aware.

  # For details regarding adding assets from package dependencies, see
  # https://flutter.dev/assets-and-images/#from-packages

  # To add custom fonts to your application, add a fonts section here,
  # in this "flutter" section. Each entry in this list should have a
  # "family" key with the font family name, and a "fonts" key with a
  # list giving the asset and other descriptors for the font. For
  # example:
  # Custom fonts (https://docs.flutter.dev/cookbook/design/fonts)
  fonts:
    - family: NotoSansKR
      fonts:
        - asset: fonts/NotoSansKR-Regular.otf
    - family: NotoSansJP
      fonts:
        - asset: fonts/NotoSansJP-Regular.otf
    - family: HanaMinA
      fonts:
        - asset: fonts/HanaMinA.ttf
    - family: HanaMinB
      fonts:
        - asset: fonts/HanaMinB.ttf
    - family: HanaMinC
      fonts:
        - asset: fonts/HanaMinC.otf
    - family: NotoSansCH
      fonts:
        - asset: fonts/NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf
    - family: GentiumPlus
      fonts:
        - asset: fonts/GentiumPlus-Regular.ttf
  #
  # For details regarding fonts from package dependencies,
  # see https://flutter.dev/custom-fonts/#from-packages

# AndroidX migration (https://docs.flutter.dev/development/androidx-migration)
module:
  androidX: true
